direction: Forward sampling transform maps before-RAS output physical points to during-RAS input physical points; the reverse is its validated inverse. SITK internal LPS conversion is explicit in the pinned helper.

evaluation.convention: Creator instructions: world millimetres, reference image coordinates first, corresponding second; MINC/NIfTI share world coordinates. For the declared beforeUS-duringUS pair: first before, second during. Future evaluator must verify actual file/header binding before computing TRE.
future_scalar_readout: Identity and rigid TRE in mm on identical eligible correspondences
Per-point errors, mean, median, RMS, maximum, count and any rejected records
TRE difference and paired direction/frame controls
evaluation.limitations: Independent of fitting inputs for this fixed TRAIN case; not a protected-cohort generalization result, complete registration uncertainty, or clinical safety bound. A rigid update cannot represent local nonrigid resection deformation.
release_requirements: Successful supervision and immutable transform hash
Later ROOT release bound to fit result and transform hashes
All full-tag points evaluation only; no fitting, initialization, case selection, parameter selection, or refitting
Record invalid points or frame failure; do not silently discard unfavorable landmarks
evaluation.short_tag_use: unused; overlapping short/full sets cannot be independent fitting/evaluation sets

failures: Record failed overlap, source/role/runtime mismatch, nonfinite data, timeout, sampled memory stop, optimizer failure, invalid transform, or cleanup failure. No fallback, retry, alternate case, tuning, or landmark inspection.
freeze: Exclusive output directory under outputs/; successful supervision receipt and fresh source/runtime/code fixity required before frozen-transform.json and result.json. No full fitted matrix or candidate in Git. Interrupted or failed candidates remain ineligible even if a candidate file exists.
initialization: Euler3D physical identity; rotation center is image support-derived, with zero initial rotation and translation. No centers-of-mass alignment or landmark initialization.
intensity_processing: Preserve active source sform and source NIfTI scaling; float32 decode only after release; fixed 1st/99th percentile clipping on positive-signal support, moving clipping on positive signal; linear 1.5 mm resampling. No segmentation or normalization parameter search.
metric_support: Fixed positive ultrasound signal inside one-voxel native geometric coverage; intersect moving native geometric coverage at identity on the 1.5 mm grid; erode two coarse voxels. Image-derived metric support only, never a brain, tissue, tumor, cavity, vessel, or safe-access mask.

unknowns: Before-US can precede or follow dura opening; filenames do not establish precise exposure or timing.
No operative timestamp, tracked instrument trajectory, microscope view, coagulation state, pressure, force, perfusion, or tissue material property is supplied by this pair.
Source grid spacing is not independently verified effective acquisition resolution.

purpose: One image-only rigid candidate versus physical identity, followed only after immutable freeze and separate ROOT release by independent full-tag landmark TRE evaluation. No policy, simulation, biomechanics, or clinical validity claim.

rights.lineage: Publisher NIfTI observations/conversions, not raw DICOM. The during original resides beside annotation acquisitions but is source-MD5-bound to the original RESECT release. RESECT-SEG CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 cavity labels are not read or used. Retain attribution and identify later image processing.

selection: First numeric declared-ID TRAIN case without the already executed Case2 sparse-update result. Case3 had earlier cavity structural QC, not an independent held-out patient. Case4 DEVELOPMENT, SELECT, and MEASUREMENT_EVAL remain protected.
supervision: One worker, two threads; 180 s optimizer/240 s supervised worker, 0.2 s sampled worker-family RSS stop above 4 GiB. Record sampled peak worker/family RSS and minimum available memory; always attempt process-group cleanup and reap. Sampling can miss transient peaks and is not an OS hard memory limit.
